item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 13/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, it will be hot with a few showers over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. A broad trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. The trough of low pressure is expected to linger over the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea early next week. The weather will remain unsettled over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Ampil will intensify gradually in the next couple of days. It will move across the seas south of Japan and edge closer to the vicinity of the eastern part of Honshu of Japan.
